subTagline: Experience premium hair, skin, and nail care with our master stylists and estheticians.
aboutDescription: Lumina Salon & Spa was founded on a simple principle: beauty is a feeling. We go beyond just aesthetics to provide a relaxing, rejuvenating experience that leaves you feeling as good as you look. Our team of master stylists and estheticians stay ahead of the latest trends to bring you the best in hair, skin, and nail care.
